justification: Both are rounded-topped stone monuments carved in low relief with a horizontally banded surface and circular/disc elements, displayed upright on museum mounts, which gives an immediate silhouette resemblance. Beyond that the schemes diverge sharply: A is a small pale slab with finely incised, register-organised seated figures above rows of script signs, while B is a massive dark boulder-like block whose carving forms a single frontal head-and-body figure with heavy modelled relief and no linear inscription.
